## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #285 implements the final focused slice for parent issue #277 via child issue #284: fork-backed external install PR mechanics for `/install owner/repo`.
- It adds a typed install fork/PR helper and CLI that validate a public target, create or reuse the token owner fork, prepare an install branch, push to the fork, and open or reuse a PR against the original repository.
- It also updates the install skill and setup/configuration docs to describe `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT`, blocked states, and onboarding-aware PR body expectations.
- This PR is intentionally stacked on PR #283, which plumbs `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` into the install route.

## Review
- The direction and scope match the parent plan, and the rubrics review found the implementation aligned with the requested minimal `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` design.
- One reviewer found a concrete idempotency bug in the existing-PR reuse path; current PR code supports that finding, so this needs a branch fix before shipping.
- A second reviewer found meaningful test coverage gaps around primary publish success and prepare reuse paths.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Existing install PR reuse can fail on rerun | BLOCKING | `prepareInstallForkPr` clones the target default branch, but `publishInstallForkPr` pushes `HEAD:<branch>` directly to the fork. When reusing an existing PR, the new commit is often not a descendant of the existing fork branch tip, so the push can fail as non-fast-forward. |
| Install helper success/reuse coverage is incomplete | WARNING | Tests cover duplicate blocking, push failure, and publish reuse with a fake runner, but they do not cover new PR creation or the prepare-time same-owner reusable PR output. |

## Progress
- Reviewed the current PR conversation, issue #284, parent issue #277, all review artifacts, current PR files, existing inline comments, and review threads.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty before synthesis.
- Posted one new inline comment on `.agent/src/install-fork-pr.ts` line 529 for the blocking reuse-push issue.
- Rubrics review passed with no rubric-specific follow-up.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Existing install PR reuse can fail on rerun</summary>

**Cause:** [`prepareInstallForkPr`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1df87d5dcefe3de4e5ed09790c620fa9b036638a/.agent/src/install-fork-pr.ts#L440-L450) records an existing reusable PR but still prepares a fresh branch from the target default branch. Later, [`publishInstallForkPr`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1df87d5dcefe3de4e5ed09790c620fa9b036638a/.agent/src/install-fork-pr.ts#L528-L529) pushes that unrelated local HEAD directly to the fork branch.

**Candidate solutions:** Prepare from the existing fork branch when reusing a PR, or record the expected remote branch OID and push the agent-owned install branch with `--force-with-lease`. Add a real git regression test for rerunning against an existing fork branch with prior commits.

**Comments:** Codex marked this blocking. Claude and the rubrics review did not raise it, but the current code supports the failure mode.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Install helper success/reuse coverage is incomplete</summary>

**Cause:** [`install-fork-pr.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1df87d5dcefe3de4e5ed09790c620fa9b036638a/.agent/src/__tests__/install-fork-pr.test.ts#L155) covers publish reuse, but the fake runner does not model non-fast-forward branch state. The suite also lacks tests for the no-existing-PR `gh pr create` path and for prepare returning `reusedPr: true`.

**Candidate solutions:** Add focused tests for new PR creation, prepare-time same-owner PR reuse, and the rerun/non-fast-forward case using a real git fixture or a runner that accurately models remote branch ancestry.

**Comments:** This is not a separate design blocker, but it should be addressed with the branch fix because the current fake runner let the reuse bug pass.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: the unresolved idempotency bug requires a concrete branch change and is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Fix existing install PR reuse so reruns update the fork branch without non-fast-forward push failures.
- [ ] Add regression coverage for rerunning against an existing fork branch, plus focused tests for new PR creation and prepare-time same-owner PR reuse.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Existing install PR lookup can miss older PRs</summary>

**Cause:** [`listOpenInstallPrs`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/54564a4fe90e14c423ab68c5d5645c019ffe813c/.agent/src/install-fork-pr.ts#L312-L323) calls `gh pr list --state open` and then filters locally by `headRefName`. The installed `gh` help reports `--limit` defaults to 30, so an older `agent/install-agent-infra` PR can be outside the fetched window.

**Candidate solutions:** Use a focused lookup for the install branch, such as a paginated GraphQL/API query filtered by `headRefName`, or otherwise request enough paginated results before deciding reuse or duplicate state. Add a focused test where matching install PRs appear outside the first result window.

**Comments:** This is a new warning from Codex. Claude and the rubrics review did not raise it, but the current code and CLI behavior support the concern.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: the remaining issue is a concrete branch change in the install PR lookup and is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
